title: Digital Footprint Risk Calculator - Assess Your Online Privacy
metaDescription: Calculate your digital footprint risk score. Assess social media exposure, data broker presence, and online visibility to protect your privacy.
description: Evaluate your digital footprint risk level by analyzing your online presence across social media, search engines, and data brokers. Get personalized recommendations to reduce your digital exposure and protect your privacy.

inputs.label: Number of Active Social Media Profiles
inputs.helpText: Count profiles you actively use (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.)

inputs.label: Social Media Privacy Settings
inputs.helpText: Overall privacy level of your social media accounts

inputs.label: Personal Info in Search Results
inputs.helpText: What appears when you Google your name

inputs.label: Data Broker Opt-outs Completed
inputs.helpText: Approximate number of data broker removal requests you've submitted

inputs.label: Estimated Online Accounts
inputs.helpText: Total accounts across all websites and services

inputs.helpText: Do you regularly use incognito mode or privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser

inputs.helpText: Voter records, property records, business filings, etc.

outputFields.label: Digital Footprint Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall risk level of your current digital footprint (0-100)

outputFields.label: Major Exposure Points

formula: let baseScore = 0; const weights = { socialMedia: socialMediaProfiles * (privacySettings === 'public' ? 4 : privacySettings === 'mixed' ? 3 : privacySettings === 'private' ? 2 : 1), searchVisibility: searchResults === 'concerning' ? 25 : searchResults === 'extensive' ? 20 : searchResults === 'moderate' ? 15 : searchResults === 'minimal' ? 8 : 0, dataBrokerRisk: Math.max(0, 20 - (dataBrokers * 0.4)), accountSpread: onlineAccounts * 0.15, publicRecords: publicRecords === 'extensive' ? 15 : publicRecords === 'significant' ? 12 : publicRecords === 'some' ? 8 : 3 }; baseScore = weights.socialMedia + weights.searchVisibility + weights.dataBrokerRisk + weights.accountSpread + weights.publicRecords; if (usePrivateBrowsing) baseScore -= 5; const riskScore = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round(baseScore))); const riskLevel = riskScore >= 70 ? 'High Risk' : riskScore >= 40 ? 'Medium Risk' : riskScore >= 20 ? 'Low Risk' : 'Minimal Risk'; const exposurePoints = (socialMediaProfiles > 8 ? 1 : 0) + (privacySettings === 'public' ? 1 : 0) + (searchResults === 'extensive' || searchResults === 'concerning' ? 1 : 0) + (dataBrokers < 10 ? 1 : 0) + (publicRecords === 'extensive' ? 1 : 0); return { riskScore, riskLevel, exposurePoints };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your digital footprint risk by analyzing key exposure factors including social media presence, search engine visibility, data broker listings, and public records. The scoring system weighs each factor based on privacy research and expert recommendations to provide an overall risk assessment.
tips: Audit your social media privacy settings quarterly and limit public posts containing personal information
Use privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser to reduce tracking and passive data collection
Submit opt-out requests to major data brokers like Spokeo, WhitePages, and BeenVerified regularly
Google yourself monthly to monitor what personal information appears in search results
Consider using aliases or separate email addresses for non-essential online accounts

interpretation.label: Minimal Risk
interpretation.description: Your digital footprint is well-managed with minimal privacy exposure. Continue monitoring and maintain current practices.

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Generally good privacy practices with some room for improvement. Focus on tightening social media settings and reducing unnecessary accounts.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Moderate privacy exposure requiring attention. Prioritize data broker opt-outs and review search result visibility.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy concerns requiring immediate action. Focus on securing social media, removing data broker listings, and limiting public information.
